info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Disbursement Management API
info.description: The Disbursement Management API enables financial institutions to efficiently manage and update disbursement transactions. This API allows users to modify details related to specific disbursements identified by their unique IDs. Typical consumers include developers working on banking applications that require real-time updates to payment information or adjustments to previously issued disbursements. This functionality is essential for maintaining accurate financial records and ensuring compliance with regulatory standards.
